rationale.consistency: Follows Caddy idioms (license header, interface guards, dispenser parsing, humanize sizes, RegisterHandlerDirective); but handler JSON uses time.Duration instead of caddy.Duration and names the chunk field write_max_chunk vs server's max_write_chunk.
rationale.edge_cases: Hard-deadline cap, chunked Write/ReadFrom with LimitReader fast path, and negative/zero values are handled; but MinRate with Timeout=0 yields an immediately-expired deadline, Write(nil) no longer triggers header write, and write-less responses never arm/refresh the deadline.
rationale.scope: Implements exactly the requested server fields, Caddyfile options, handler module, directive ordering and standard import; no unrelated edits.
rationale.readability: Clear small types (IdleDeadline next/progress) with purposeful comments; wrapping blocks are explicit and easy to follow.
rationale.robustness: SetDeadline errors only logged at debug via a nil-unsafe Logger field (panics if unset); stale HTTP/1 write deadline can persist across keep-alive when a later response writes nothing; no config validation of nonsensical values.
rationale.maintainability: Shared IdleDeadline/reader/writer types reused by server and handler avoid logic duplication, though the wrapping boilerplate is repeated in two places and read/write Caddyfile parsing is copy-pasted.
